raw_segments.text: Titania. Be kind and courteous to this gentleman. Hop in his walks and gamble in his eyes. Feed
him with apricots and do-berries with purple grapes, green figs, and mulberries. The honey
bags steal from the humble bees, and for night tapers crop their waxen thighs and light them
at the fiery glowworm's eyes to have my love to bed and to arise. And pluck the wings from
painted butterflies to fan the moonbeams from his sleeping eyes. Nod to him, elves, and
